title: Why your phone is secretly an AI supercomputer

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Your phone isn’t just a device — it’s a pocket-sized AI supercomputer.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Right now, AI is changing how we live, work, and interact with tech.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s running advanced AI models like Google’s Gemini and Apple’s Neural Engine.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Your phone uses on-device AI to process data without sending it to the cloud.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects your privacy, security, and even how fast your apps run.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Your phone is smarter than you think — and it’s getting smarter fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how AI is reshaping your daily life? Tap to follow and stay ahead.
